title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: compoundAlgorithm
text:
compound algorithm
compound algorithm
(definition)
Definition:
An
algorithm
in which one or more of the computable steps is a call to execute another algorithm.
Generalization
(I am a kind of ...)
algorithm
.
See also
primitive algorithm
.
Note:
Any
algorithm
is either a
primitive algorithm
or a
compound algorithm
.  The distinction between primitive and compound is somewhat subjective.
Author:
VP
More information
Vreda Pieterse
,
Topic Maps for Specifying Algorithm Taxonomies: A Case using Transitive Closure Algorithms
, doctoral dissertation, University of Pretoria, 2016.
